## Schedule 
The schedule at a glance can be found <a href="images/ProgramLayout.png">here</a>.

The information shown below is current as of the 20th October 2026. The schedule is subject to change without notice.


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(yaml)
library(htmltools)

program <- suppressWarnings(
  read_yaml("_schedule.yml")
)
```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

library(yaml)

program <- suppressWarnings(
  read_yaml("_schedule.yml")
)

cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n")

for(day in program$days){

  cat(paste0("### ", day$name, "\n\n"))

  for(session in day$sessions){

    cat(
      sprintf(
        '<div class="schedule-card %s">\n',
        session$type
      )
    )

    # Time

    if(!is.null(session$time)){

      cat(
        sprintf(
          '<div class="schedule-time">%s</div>\n',
          session$time
        )
      )

    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sessions WITH talks (Keynotes / Contributed Sessions)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    if(!is.null(session$talks)){

      # Session title

      if(!is.null(session$session_no)){

        cat(
          sprintf(
            '<div class="schedule-title">%s</div>\n',
            session$session_no
          )
        )

      }

      # Chair

      if(!is.null(session$chair)){

        cat(
          sprintf(
            '<div class="schedule-chair">Chair: %s</div>\n',
            session$chair
          )
        )

      }

      cat("<details>\n")
      cat("<summary>Details</summary>\n")

      for(talk in session$talks){

        cat('<div class="talk-entry">\n')

        # Talk time (optional)

        if(!is.null(talk$time)){

          cat(
            sprintf(
              '<div class="talk-time">%s</div>\n',
              talk$time
            )
          )

        }

        # Talk title

        if(!is.null(talk$title)){

          cat(
            sprintf(
              '<div class="talk-title">%s</div>\n',
              talk$title
            )
          )

        }

        # Speaker

        if(!is.null(talk$speaker)){

          cat(
            sprintf(
              '<div class="talk-speaker">%s</div>\n',
              talk$speaker
            )
          )

        }

        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # ABSTRACT
        # ------------------------------------------------------------

        if(!is.null(talk$abstract)){

          cat('<details class="abstract-details">\n')
          cat('<summary>Abstract</summary>\n')

          abstract_paragraphs <-
            strsplit(
              talk$abstract,
              "\n\n"
            )[[1]]

          for(p in abstract_paragraphs){

            cat(
              sprintf(
                "<p>%s</p>\n",
                p
              )
            )

          }

          cat('</details>\n')

        }

        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # BIOGRAPHY
        # ------------------------------------------------------------

        if(!is.null(talk$bio)){

          cat('<details class="bio-details">\n')
          cat('<summary>Biography</summary>\n')

          bio_paragraphs <-
            strsplit(
              talk$bio,
              "\n\n"
            )[[1]]

          for(p in bio_paragraphs){

            cat(
              sprintf(
                "<p>%s</p>\n",
                p
              )
            )

          }

          cat('</details>\n')

        }

        cat('</div>\n')

      }

      cat('</details>\n')

    } else {

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------
      # Sessions WITHOUT talks
      # Registration / Break / Social / Opening / Closing
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------

      if(!is.null(session$title)){

        cat(
          sprintf(
            '<div class="schedule-title">%s</div>\n',
            session$title
          )
        )

      }

      if(!is.null(session$speaker)){

        cat(
          sprintf(
            '<div class="schedule-speaker">%s</div>\n',
            session$speaker
          )
        )

      }

    }

    cat("</div>\n\n")

  }

}

cat(":::\n")
```
